glossary_entries.gene: A stretch of DNA that helps cells work. Some genes help make proteins; others help control genes.
glossary_entries.copy: One version of a gene at a matching place in a chromosome pair.
glossary_entries.carrier: In this recessive model, someone with one working copy and one changed copy.
glossary_entries.recessive: An inheritance pattern where changes in both copies can be linked to a condition.
glossary_entries.chance: A model describes possibilities, not a promise about one person.
glossary_entries.ancestor: A person in an earlier generation of a family.
glossary_entries.negative: A test did not find the change it looked for. Scope and detection still matter.
glossary_entries.uncertain: The available information does not settle the health meaning of a gene change.
glossary_entries.counsellor: A genetics professional who can discuss information and choices without directing your decision.

options.title: Talk with a genetic counsellor
options.body: Discuss what is known, what is uncertain, and what matters to you.

options.title: Ask about further testing
options.body: Explore what another test could or could not clarify.

options.title: Explore reproductive options
options.body: Ask which options exist in your circumstances, without committing to any route.

options.title: Continue as planned
options.body: You can discuss support and questions without choosing a different path.
